HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc. 2nd Bail Application No. 609/2023 Sita Ram S/o Sh. Bala Ram, Aged About 39 Years, R/o Kitasar Bhatiyan, P.s. Sri Dungargarh, Dist. Bikaner (Raj.).

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Lodged In Dist. Jail, Bikaner).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. C.S. Rathore For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.K. Mehar, PP  Mr. R.K. Chotia for the complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 20/01/2023

The present second bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioner, who is in judicial custody in connection with F.I.R. No.356/2022, Police Station Dungargarh, District Bikaner registered for the offences punishable under Sections 452, 341,
323, 354 and 376 of the IPC.
The first bail application was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 17.11.2022 with liberty to file a fresh bail application after filing of the challan.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that according to FIR as well as statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., no specific allegation for committing rape with her has been levelled against the petitioner.
Later on, in statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., an allegation of (2 of 2) [CRLMB-609/2023] committing rape with her is levelled against the petitioner.
Counsel submits that prosecutrix is a major.
Challan of the case has been presented and no investigation is pending against the petitioner.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time.
With these submissions, learned counsel for the petitioner prayed that the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.

sentences.text: I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the second bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner - Sita Ram S/o Sh. Bala Ram, shall be released on bail in connection with F.I.R.
No.356/2022, Police Station Dungargarh, District Bikaner provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 143-Rashi/-
